apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
- Added experimental support for installing Altstore using the "Custom .ipa" feature
    - Added support for "ALTDeviceID" for those who install Altstore using Custom .ipa
    - SideInstaller will auto-insert the pairing file into Altstore if installed using Custom.ipa
- Fixed a bug caused by background task IDs (iLoader issue #649)
- Added app groups to extensions
